text: Meet Kame Homes. Everything you need to run your rentals, in one place.
Setup takes minutes. A guided checklist walks you through every step.
See all your properties and parking spots together, with revenue and occupancy.
Each property gets a simple home page: earnings, your calendar, and what needs you today.
Bookings move forward on their own. Documents, receipts, and guest emails are handled for you.
Prefer a board? Drag a booking to its next step, or add one by hand.
Moving from a spreadsheet? Upload it, and AI fills in the right fields.
Connect Airbnb once. Bookings and blocked dates stay in sync both ways.
Set your rates on a calendar, or turn on Smart Pricing and let AI suggest them.
Income is recorded automatically. Add expenses and see your real profit.
Schedule upkeep, get reminders, and check off tasks as you go.
Analytics shows how you are doing, and an AI review tells you what to improve.
Facebook, Instagram, and website chat land in one inbox. AI drafts the replies.
Guests can call Kame, your AI receptionist. It answers questions about your place, day or night.
Your listing, stay guide, and showcase page update live as you edit.
Guests find you in search or on your own page, pick open dates, and book in a few taps.
Once booked, guests get a stay guide, chat with you anytime, and earn a voucher when they leave a review.
Customize every guest email, and preview exactly what guests will see.
Content Studio makes calendars, social posts, and short videos for your property.
Describe a shot, add your photos, and AI creates posts and images that look like your place.
Pick a photo and a camera move. AI turns it into a short video clip.
Invite your team, and choose exactly what each person can see and do.
Get instant Telegram alerts for bookings, messages, and maintenance.
Switch to AI mode, ask in plain words, and the right page opens beside the chat.
Simple plans, priced per property, with one bill for your whole organization.
Kame Homes. Less busywork, more happy guests. Start free today.
